It maintains global leadership in the temporary power generation marketplace by offering innovative rental solutions. Aggreko is a major player in the global power market. About Us
Resource Corner Pty Ltd has been built on the principles of integrity, partnership, and innovation, traits that have allowed Resource Corner to establish itself as a leader in its field since 2006. We are a global technology enterprise focused on delivering excellence in complex digital environments with a strong presence in IT consulting and services.

Job location:
Head Office is in Norwest Business Park, Norwest NSW 2153. You may be required to work at client sites (multiple locations possible), while remaining a direct employee of Resource Corner.

Type of position: Permanent, ongoing

Minimum Qualification: Any bachelor’s degree in computing or related field

Experience Range: 5 to 15 years

Job Description – Software Engineer
As a Software Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining software applications and solutions. The role involves working with stakeholders to understand requirements, developing scalable and efficient systems, and ensuring applications meet performance and quality standards.

Detailed Job Description

Primary/Mandatory Skills:
•	Minimum 5 years of professional experience in software engineering
•	Strong programming skills in Java / .NET / Python
•	Experience with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP)
•	Good knowledge of APIs, microservices, and web applications
•	Solid experience with relational databases (Oracle/SQL/MySQL)
•	Strong understanding of SDLC and Agile methodologies

Skillset Required:
•	Hands-on experience with Spring Boot, Microservices, REST APIs
•	Database design and optimization
•	Exposure to containerization and CI/CD tools (Docker, Jenkins, Git)
•	Excellent problem-solving and communication skills

Good to Have:
•	Experience with DevOps practices and Terraform
•	Knowledge of security best practices and system integration

Roles and Responsibilities:
•	Develop, build, review, and test front-end and back-end software solutions
•	Collaborate with business and technical teams to deliver high-quality outcomes
•	Perform troubleshooting, debugging, and optimization of applications
•	Prepare technical documentation and contribute to system design

Salary: $100k to $150k plus super

Next Steps
If this role matches your skills and career aspirations, we’d love to hear from you. Please apply directly with Resource Corner.

About Us

Sizzle N Sambar is a well-established Indian restaurant based in Victoria Park and Willetton in Western Australia, known for delivering authentic, high-quality cuisine. We are currently seeking an experienced and qualified Full-Time Restaurant Manager to oversee the restaurant operations and support our growing hospitality business.

About the Role
The Restaurant Manager will be responsible for managing daily restaurant operations, maintaining high standards of food quality and customer service, supervising staff, and ensuring smooth coordination between front-of-house and kitchen team. This is a hands-on leadership role suited to a hospitality professional with strong operational and people-management skills.

Key Duties and Responsibilities
•	Oversee day-to-day restaurant operations. 
•	Ensure high standards of customer service and customer satisfaction. 
•	Recruit, train, supervise, and roster restaurant staff. 
•	Monitor staff performance and provide ongoing support and development. 
•	Coordinate front-of-house operations to ensure efficient service during busy periods. 
•	Handle customer feedback and resolve complaints professionally and promptly. 
•	Manage stock ordering, supplier relationships, and inventory control. 
•	Monitor restaurant budgets, labour costs, and operational expenses. 
•	Ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, and workplace health and safety regulations. 
•	Work closely with chefs and kitchen staff to maintain food quality and service consistency. 
•	Coordinate and participate in promotional events to drive business growth. 
•	Maintain accurate records relating to sales, stock, staffing, and operational reporting. 
Required Qualifications and Experience
•	Diploma or Advanced Diploma in Hospitality Management or related field. 
•	Minimum One year of full-time relevant experience in restaurant or hospitality operations. 
•	Strong leadership and team management skills.

About the Business:
JG Prestige Auto Pty Ltd is an independent specialist workshop in Clayton South dedicated to Mercedes-Benz and other European vehicles. We deliver dealership-standard diagnostics, mechanical repairs, auto electrical work, air conditioning services and logbook servicing using advanced diagnostic equipment and high-grade parts. Our reputation is built on honest diagnosis, transparent upfront pricing, quality workmanship and a 24-month/20,000 km warranty. We value precision, clear communication and genuine customer care in a professional, well-equipped workshop environment that prioritises accuracy over shortcuts.
About the Position:
The Automotive Technician (Motor Mechanic) is responsible for diagnosing, maintaining and repairing Mercedes-Benz and European vehicles to a high technical standard. This hands-on role is central to delivering reliable, dealership-level service without the dealership price tag, ensuring vehicles leave the workshop performing safely and smoothly while supporting the growth of a specialist independent business.
Key Responsibilities:
Diagnose mechanical and electrical faults using advanced diagnostic equipment (including Xentry/ISTA and similar systems) and interpret live data and fault codes accurately.
Perform scheduled logbook servicing and routine maintenance to manufacturer specifications.
Repair and replace components including engines, transmissions, braking systems, steering, suspension, cooling systems, clutches and related mechanical assemblies.
Carry out auto electrical repairs, battery/charging system diagnostics, and air conditioning inspections, leak testing and re-gassing.
Dismantle, inspect, repair or replace worn or defective parts and reassemble components to correct specifications, referring to service manuals and technical data.
Road-test vehicles where required and verify repairs meet performance and safety standards.
Maintain a clean, organised and safe workshop environment, complete job cards accurately and communicate findings clearly to the business owner/customers.
Source and fit OEM or equivalent high-grade parts and support transparent quoting processes.
Requirements:
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
Certificate III in Automotive Technology, Certificate III in Light Vehicle Mechanical Technology, or an equivalent recognised qualification.
Minimum 4 years’ experience as a qualified Automotive Technician / Motor Mechanic.
Strong technical skills in diagnosing and repairing modern European vehicles, including familiarity with electronic control systems and diagnostic software.
Excellent attention to detail, problem-solving ability, clear communication skills and a professional, customer-focused approach.
Ability to work independently, follow manufacturer procedures, and maintain high standards of workmanship and workshop safety.
